title: Testing and Deploying React Apps
description: Learn how to write tests for React components using React Testing Library (RTL) and deploy React apps easily using platforms like Vercel and Netlify.

lessons.title: Why Testing is Important
lessons.content: Testing ensures code reliability, reduces bugs, and improves maintainability of React applications.

lessons.title: Introduction to React Testing Library (RTL)
lessons.content: RTL focuses on testing React components by simulating user interactions, prioritizing testing behavior over implementation details.

lessons.title: Setting Up RTL in a React Project
Writing Your First Test with RTL
Testing User Interactions
Mocking API Calls in Tests
lessons.content: Use tools like Jest mocks or MSW (Mock Service Worker) to simulate API responses for reliable and isolated tests.

lessons.title: Introduction to Deployment Platforms
lessons.content: Vercel and Netlify provide easy-to-use, free hosting platforms optimized for React apps with features like continuous deployment and CDN.

lessons.title: Deploying React App on Vercel
lessons.content:
1. Connect your GitHub repo to Vercel.
2. Configure build settings (usually `npm run build`).
3. Deploy and get your live URL instantly.

lessons.title: Deploying React App on Netlify
lessons.content:
1. Connect GitHub repo to Netlify.
2. Set build command `npm run build` and publish directory `build/`.
3. Deploy with automatic continuous updates.

lessons.title: Best Practices for Testing and Deployment
lessons.content:
- Write meaningful, maintainable tests
- Use environment variables securely
- Automate deployment with CI/CD
- Monitor live app performance and errors
